# roadie_secret (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Roadie secret's metadata and status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roadie_secret" "github_token" {
  ref = "GITHUB_TOKEN"
}

output "github_token_status" {
  value = data.roadie_secret.github_token.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ref` (String) The secret reference key (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN).

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the secret.
- `help_url` (String) URL linking to documentation about obtaining this secret.
- `name` (String) Human-friendly display name.
- `status` (String) Current status: Available or Not Set.
